ai.seo_question: What does the Quran say about the defeat of Abraha's army in Surah Al-Fil?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores Allah's strategic reversal of Abraha's military might into futility, using the imagery of birds carrying clay stones to demonstrate divine power over the mighty. It serves as a foundational narrative for the preservation of the Kaaba, linking historical divine intervention to the spiritual centrality of the House of God in Islamic tradition.
